title: LLMs reward expertise
summary: This article explores how Large Language Models tend to produce better outputs when given expert-level inputs or context, essentially 'rewarding' users with domain expertise. The author argues that LLMs amplify existing knowledge gaps, making it harder for non-experts to identify errors while making experts more productive.
problem_solved: Explains why LLMs sometimes produce poor or misleading outputs and why expertise matters in AI interactions.
why_valuable: Provides crucial insights into human-AI interaction dynamics and helps users understand how to leverage their own expertise for better AI outputs.
